text:
Carmen: Heads-up 10 1 	 Drafted the changelog + release note for the caching/batching work and the Dedicated canary UX. Need a quick pass on: (1) the Known Issues section, (2) SDK snippets (py/js), and (3) the migration blurb for Private. Planning to publish tomorrow AM unless blockers.

Theo: Link?

Carmen: https://docs.internal/relnotes/draft-cache-batching-2026 (WIP).

Nina: I'll sweep anchors and redirects. I saw one redirect loop earlier for /docs/dedicated/canary -> /docs/dedicated/canary-config.

Owen: Snippet note: make sure examples show the new options shape (`cache: {kv_enabled: true}`) and also the opt-out example.

Rahul: Adding the quantization callout here: small percentage of tokenization diffs when using 4-bit kernels on very long sequences. Recommend warning + link to eval artifacts and a mitigation (re-tokenize with model vocab or bump tolerance).

Carmen: Good. Add a tiny "how to revert" for ops: example CLI and helm override.

Nina: I'll fix anchors. Also: update screenshot alt text for accessibility.

Theo: Draft Python snippet below, please sanity-check:

```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key="REDACTED")
resp = client.generate(
    model="redwood-optim-1",
    input="Summarize the change",
    options={"cache": {"kv_enabled": True}, "batch": {"max_tokens": 1024}},
)
print(resp.text)
```

Owen: Minor nit: in SDK v0.9 the options namespace is `client.options` vs passing raw dict. Add a short note: "SDK example shows v1-style args; if you're on v0.9 see migration note."

Carmen: Add that migration note to the Snippets section. Also include a JS streaming example and the one-liner rollback: `kubectl -n redwood rollout restart deploy/inference-worker --container inference-worker`

Rahul: Known issue to add: Private (VPC) customers who pin model variants may see prefix cache misses after a restart; workaround is to run a warmup job that primes the KV for pinned variants. I'll draft the warmup command and a sample curl.

Nina: docs-bot: please queue linkcheck + snippet-lint for 2026-03-24T19:00:00Z.

docs-bot: Queued linkcheck and snippet-linter for 2026-03-24T19:00:00Z.

Theo: Also can we add a short metric in the blurb: "internal bench: up to 18% per-route token cost reduction with default cache + batching". Mark as internal (non-public) unless legal approves.

Carmen: Marked internal. For public release we'll say "measurable per-route cost savings" and point to a whitepaper later.

Owen: One more ask: include a tiny migration checklist for Private customers with the config diff (`kv_cache.enabled` -> `cache.kv_enabled`) and the helm override example.

Rahul: I'll add the migration checklist + warmup snippet.

Nina: After linkcheck, I can run the redirect sweep. If anchors still break, I'll drop a note and revert the screenshot rename.

Carmen: Great. Plan: I9ll flip the draft to "ready for review" after you all push edits. If any blocker surfaces during the linting, @Carmen will triage. :thumbsup:
